facts.fact: Carson 在早上九点前已喂 Blueberry、查看牛、回了十四封邮件、发现 Rosie 订的便携洗手站漏水、走两遍临时停车场并调解两名摊主争入口位
facts.anchor: By nine that morning, I had already fed Blueberry, checked on the cows, answered fourteen emails

facts.fact: Rosie 距节日四十八小时又加订二百个南瓜，Carson 把这事当作当天灾难之一讲给 Beau 听
facts.anchor: Rosie deciding we need another two hundred pumpkins forty-eight hours before the festival

facts.fact: Carson 承认五年来一直没把左腿的事告诉男人，原打算当晚告诉 Beau
facts.anchor: I had been waiting for five years.

facts.fact: 醉驾司机在 Willow Creek 外几小时处撞上 Carson，卡车翻滚，她的左腿被卡住
facts.anchor: A drunk driver hit me a few hours outside Willow Creek.

facts.fact: Beau 自认识 Carson 起就几乎一直注意到她跛行，却从不追问，等她自己说
facts.anchor: Pretty much since I met you.

facts.fact: Carson 摘下假肢露出残肢后，Beau 先问能否碰她，得到点头许可才碰她的伤疤皮肤并问哪里疼
Beau 向 Carson 表白，说从她走进车库、五分钟后跟他争吵起就想要她
facts.anchor: I wanted you when you started arguing with me five minutes after I kept you from freezing to death.

facts.fact: 当晚 Carson 坐在门廊、假肢取下，Beau 吃着 Meme 的苹果派，Meme 端来整盒香草冰淇淋让 Beau 呻吟
facts.anchor: Meme returned carrying the entire carton of vanilla ice cream, and Beau groaned.
